items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He played both good, because when Eddie died, he'd taken Eddie with us in the tuxedo, brass band, to play the big horn.

ctx.x: Harmon Mitchell, we used to call him Basie. That was a short fella.
He played both good, because when Eddie died, he'd taken Eddie with us in the tuxedo, brass band, to play the big horn. And he was good.
